ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Inspect tabs
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Reusable Pickle steps that open a pawn's inspect tabs (Gear, Bio, Health, Social, Needs, Log) and check which one is open. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See InspectTabs/README.md at the repository root.
A copy of RimWorks/Rimworld-Pickle#31, kept in step with it until it merges. The steps sit under a text of their own ("Nelim's Pickle Tools: ...") so they can never be ambiguous with Pickle's; when Pickle ships the same steps this mod's can go.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
